method: Decoded reference samples at two-second intervals over the full 30-second duration; full-resolution reference frames at 15 and 28 seconds; generated preview frames at 1.667, 8.333, 15, 21.667 and 28.333 seconds. Decoded output contact sheets inspected after rendering. This is a sampled review, not a frame-by-frame transition acceptance audit.

observations: Preserves the requested 30-second recipe progression with visible ingredients and measurements.
Chooses a 1600x900 sans-serif editorial layout, different from the original 1280x720 handwritten board.
Chooses 2 oz vodka, 1 oz coffee liqueur and 1 oz cream; source film uses 1.5, 0.75 and 0.75 oz. The ratio is the same, serving size differs.
Uses five ice cubes and a generic pouring cup, rather than the reference's three cubes and distinct bottles.
baseline.render_preprocessing: HyperFrames added editor data-hf-id attributes only; generated animation code was not manually repaired.

adapted.shared_asset: Caveat.ttf (Google Fonts, SIL OFL), provided for attempts 2 and 3; font approximation, not model-generated artwork
observations: Attempt 1 followed the reviewer's mistaken left-sidebar reconstruction; preserved as an archived attempt.
Attempt 2 restores the right sidebar, top progress line, reference quantities, handwritten typography and reference framing.
Attempt 3 raises the final fill to the 3 oz line, floats the ice, replaces repeated cream lobes with soft procedural clouds, adjusts straw scale and restores the progressive lower-left closing.
All five recipe steps, completed drink, checklist and silent 30-second runtime are present.
remaining_differences: Pencil geometry, container silhouettes, cube contours and paper texture are procedural approximations.
Cream movement is a deterministic visual approximation rather than a recovered fluid simulation.
The original font family is unknown; Caveat is separately supplied.
Exact entrance/exit timing across every transition boundary has not been fully audited.
At synchronized t=23.13s the reference still displays the cream step while the adaptation has begun the stir instruction; transition timing still needs refinement.

technical_limits: Canvas text has no DOM text boxes; automated contrast/layout checked zero text nodes.
The reproduction passes with a nonfatal source-length warning.
comparison_claim: The adapted track uses additional reference evidence, prompts, a supplied font and multiple iterations. It demonstrates reproduction improvement in this case; it is not a controlled model ranking or proof of visual parity.

playback_check.observation: Both videos played in the gallery and paused within 0.003s of one another.
